#****************************************************************************
#* svcheck_sem -- the curated SV model (svcheck-design §3.6, svcheck-plan
#* P1.3): classes and reflection tables generated by pyastbuilder from
#* src/ast/*.yaml (scripts/gen_sem_model.py).
#*
#* Generated at configure time, since the sources it writes depend on the
#* yaml's classes; an edit to the yaml or the script reconfigures. The
#* generator runs locally: the configure stays offline.
#****************************************************************************
set(_sem_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen")
file(GLOB _sem_yaml CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.yaml")
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
  ${_sem_yaml} "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/gen_sem_model.py")

execute_process(
  COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/gen_sem_model.py"
          "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" "${_sem_dir}" "${PACKAGES_DIR}"
  RESULT_VARIABLE _sem_rc)
if (NOT _sem_rc EQUAL 0)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "svcheck: generating the curated model failed (scripts/gen_sem_model.py)")
endif()

file(GLOB _sem_src "${_sem_dir}/*.cpp" "${_sem_dir}/reflect/*.cpp")
add_library(svcheck_sem STATIC ${_sem_src})
target_include_directories(svcheck_sem
  PUBLIC "${_sem_dir}/include"
  PRIVATE "${_sem_dir}")
target_link_libraries(svcheck_sem PUBLIC svcheck_engine)
set_target_properties(svcheck_sem PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
# The implementation headers (the concrete classes), for the lowering pass.
set(SVCHECK_SEM_IMPL_DIR "${_sem_dir}" PARENT_SCOPE)
